title: Hard as a rock! This is terrible, returned it.
text: Hard as a rock! This is terrible, returned it.. Ummm...wow...this simply has to be the worst pillow I've ever purchased. I wanted it for two 15 hour one way flights - totally useless. The foam is like a solid, hard mass and has zero flexibility or movement. I tried it for 10 minutes on the sofa and in an arm chair - similar to the position one would have in an airplane seat. Trying to sleep on this pillow or using it for support on a long flight would assure you a sore neck. It is hard to the touch - I've never seen a memory foam that won't give at all. I am returning it immediately and ordering the Z by Malouf travel pillow instead. Should have listened to my husband and purchased the Malouf in the first place!
